h.A DENIA melhora processos, mas não garan: DENIA improves processes, but does not guarantee business results, such as number of sales, customers, followers or reviews, average rating, reach, Google ranking, return on investment or revenue. These results depend on factors beyond our control, such as the market, the Customer's own offer and customer service, platform algorithms and competition. Figures, examples and demos shown on the website are illustrative.
h.A DENIA é um software como serviço (SaaS: DENIA is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) with artificial intelligence that helps businesses serve customers, organize operations and produce marketing content. DENIA is a tool: it is not an agency, does not provide legal, medical, accounting or financial advice and does not act on behalf of the Customer beyond the functions the Customer itself configures and approves.
h.A DENIA é uma plataforma de inteligência: DENIA is an artificial intelligence platform for business customer service, operations and marketing. With respect to registration, usage and contact data with DENIA, we are the controller. With respect to data of end customers served by the companies that use the platform (messages, names, phone numbers, orders), the customer company is the controller and DENIA is the processor: we process this data only to provide the service and in accordance with the company's instructions.
h.A inteligência que atende como a sua mel: The intelligence that serves like your best team.

h.Você pode pedir confirmação de tratament: You may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability, deletion, information about sharing, review of automated decisions and withdrawal of consent; under the GDPR, also objection to and restriction of processing. If you are an end customer of a company that uses DENIA, preferably make the request to that company (the controller); we will help it respond. To request directly: Data deletion or Contact us. We respond within 15 days. You may also file a complaint with the Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD — Brazilian National Data Protection Authority) or the data protection authority of your country.
h.Você também pode remover o acesso pelas: You can also remove access through the platform's own settings: on Facebook/Instagram, under Settings → Security → Apps and websites; on Google, under myaccount.google.com → Security → Apps with access to your account.
